The service was excellent, except for the female doctor wearing a black shirt on Monday, March 10th. She was rude and rude, her eyes rolling at us. We took our child there because she had chickenpox. She pressed us to confirm that the first bump on her face appeared on her body and arm. We told her we weren't being honest, and she raised her voice and glared at us. Our daughter sat quietly when the doctor asked our 7-year-old daughter her name. We told her her full name, and she asked what her nickname was. We turned to our daughter, and she remained silent. The doctor said that if she didn't answer, she could answer for her. We told her that the school was accepting a young graduate who had been sick beforehand. The doctor raised her voice at us, saying that no parent would send their child to that school. We listened to her tone and mannerisms, and we sat quietly. We had said something inappropriate, so she acted like that to us. Or did we not answer correctly? She just turned away, her back to us. What did we do so wrong? After an hour of seeing the doctor, we will never go there again. Please improve your manners and tone. Even with a mask on, you can see her eyes rolling so hard they're about to pop out of their sockets. Don't be so worried.
